title: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Study and Learn in Teams and LMS Assignments
description: Educators can assign Study and Learn from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open guided learning support grounded in the assignment's title, instructions, and supported files and resources, helping them work through concepts and practice their understanding.
